decisions.summary: Keep product repositories independent and build a portfolio-level control plane rather than a source-code monolith.
Use exact repository HEAD SHAs as the first cache key and inspect unchanged repositories only when the task specifically requires deeper evidence.
Reserve PRJ-000 for Portfolio Brain and keep stable project identities separate from repository identities.
Use four autonomy classes (OBSERVE, EXPERIMENT, MODIFY, ACT) with deny-by-default semantics and the most restrictive applicable rule winning.
No project receives unbounded external ACT authority; consequential external actions remain human-gated and market-surveillance live trading/execution remains prohibited.
Treat existing GitHub workflow write/deploy credentials as capabilities of those workflows, not as blanket authority for Portfolio Brain.
Use changed-path/risk-aware targeted test selection rather than running every downstream repository test suite after every candidate change.
Treat dependency manifests and lockfiles as promotion evidence; manifest/lockfile changes should trigger dependency-specific validation rather than relying on one successful install.
Use ARCHITECTURE_EVIDENCE_BUNDLE.json plus the current SHA delta as the canonical prework handoff into Portfolio Brain Step 0; do not rescan unchanged repositories by default.

At architecture handoff, re-inspect only the two repositories whose HEADs diverged from the pinned snapshot (github-value-hunt-ledger and abvmschoolstarworld) before completing master Step 0; keep the other five repositories cached unless a specific architecture question requires them.
Reuse canonical ai_business_os and existing TI controls through pinned interfaces; business_os remains frozen legacy.
Reuse the command center, portfolio planner and production read bridge; require separated observation credentials and authenticated human authority before runtime integration.
Treat scouts as pre-verification intake; connect findings through existing immutable run/claim/lease/verifier/outcome paths rather than create a competing Hunter control plane.
Preserve prework inventories byte-for-byte and append delta evidence; distinguish discovered tests from currently invoked CI tests.
GitHub stores code, policy and sanitized evidence receipts; private operating/customer payloads stay in authorized private storage.
Minimum budgets, timeouts, retry bounds, idempotency and kill switches are prerequisites for recurring execution before the full Step 20 governor.

Root PORTFOLIO_BUILD_STATE.json is now canonical for master steps 0–25; portfolio_prework/PORTFOLIO_BUILD_STATE.json is immutable completed prework history. current_step denotes the next pending step. Artifact commit_sha records the creation checkpoint; the containing state commit is resolved from the isolated branch HEAD to avoid a self-referential Git hash.
Record ABVM runtime and test coverage changes explicitly; green narrowed CI is not proof of inherited offline/calendar/persistence coverage.

Stage Step 1 foundation artifacts on an isolated Hunter infrastructure branch until the dedicated PRJ-000 repository can be created; this staging branch grants no downstream authority and will not be treated as the final Portfolio Brain repository.

Represent the uncreated dedicated repository with a relocatable portfolio_brain_seed manifest. The Step 1 registration mechanism is deny-by-default and grants no authority; Step 2 will expand it into the full project/autonomy/objective/metric schemas.
Initial Portfolio Brain CI is deterministic and read-only: standard-library validation only, contents:read permission, five-minute timeout, no schedule, no model/network/install/deploy/write steps.

The dedicated Portfolio Brain repository is temporarily public by explicit owner choice. Until it is made private, store only non-sensitive code, policy, schemas, build state, and sanitized evidence receipts; never store secrets, private customer/operational payloads, credentials, or sensitive evidence.
Step 1 is complete only after the dedicated repository foundation CI passes at the materialized branch head. GitHub Actions run 36152821896 succeeded at b61583369f03a4582781a418aef8a0cba318fab1.

PROJECT_SCHEMA is closed by default, keeps stable project identity separate from repository identity, binds autonomy/objective/metric references explicitly, requires provenance policy, and treats repository integration state as declared/observe/block/retired rather than as implied authority.

Autonomy registration is descriptive and deny-by-default: runtime_enabled remains false for every Step 2 profile; ACT is HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED or PROHIBITED, and builders cannot self-approve promotion.

Owner-named businesses, products, research streams and infrastructure are covered by canonical stable projects without falsely asserting that every alias, subsystem or concept is an independently validated business. Coverage status is REGISTERED_COVERAGE_ONLY.

Objectives and metrics cannot grant execution authority. Objectives require explicit evidence requirements and provenance; metrics require an explicit evidence source and OBSERVED or VERIFIED verification requirement.

Registry validation runs as a Python package module in CI so package-relative imports resolve from repository root. The initial direct-script invocation failure is permanently covered by exact-head CI.

Use one versioned universal event envelope carrying event identity/type/timestamps, project/source/actor, authority class, subjects, evidence IDs, explicit verification status, dependency and causal event links, metric observations, data classification, deterministic idempotency key and event hash.

Evidence receipts preserve explicit epistemic state OBSERVED/VERIFIED/INFERRED/UNKNOWN/CONTRADICTED/STALE/INVALID. VERIFIED requires non-model verification; MODEL_OUTPUT cannot self-verify, and INFERRED evidence requires explicit basis evidence.

Deterministic SHA-256 receipt hashes and source-event idempotency keys are mandatory. Bundle validation rejects tampered hashes, duplicate source events, unresolved evidence bases, unresolved event dependencies/causal links, and unsupported VERIFIED event claims.
PRIVATE_REFERENCE_ONLY events may carry only a redacted reference/summary envelope, preventing the event bus contract from becoming a path for raw private payloads while Portfolio Brain is public.

Repository adapters are OBSERVE-only and use exact source-SHA cursors. Unchanged sources perform one HEAD resolution and skip compare/content rereads; changed sources compare only prior cursor SHA to current head; blocked sources perform zero reads and do not advance.

Repository observation cursors are source-ref-specific and separate from architecture build-branch state. REPO-008 therefore tracks main in the adapter cursor while PORTFOLIO_BUILD_STATE.json tracks the isolated working branch used for the numbered build.

The initial Step 4 observation captured three changed repositories (67 commits, 131 changed paths total), three unchanged repositories with zero content rereads, one blocked repository with zero network reads, and one initialized default-branch cursor.

An additional accessible private repository was minimally checked for relevance; no README or code-search evidence established a portfolio mapping. It was not added to the durable adapter set, and no private content or identifying metadata was persisted in the public Portfolio Brain repository. Reconsider only after relevance is evidenced or the control repository becomes private.
Reuse the canonical AI Business OS Truth Engine through an exact source revision/blob pin and a conformance adapter; do not vendor or fork its evaluator into Portfolio Brain.

Portfolio truth projection preserves upstream semantics: PROVEN maps to VERIFIED only when all required findings are SATISFIED; CONTESTED/conflicted maps to CONTRADICTED; required stale evidence maps to STALE; NOT_PROVEN and UNKNOWN remain UNKNOWN rather than false.

Truth integration fails closed on upstream drift: the pinned source revision must equal the durable REPO-001 cursor and the pinned blob identity must match the conformance record before projection is accepted.

Repeated assertions, additional same-family support, or model confidence cannot promote a claim to VERIFIED. Evidence independence, admissible authority, freshness, contradiction handling, and the upstream proof verdict remain controlling.

Reuse canonical AI Business OS Value Memory through an exact source revision/blob pin. Portfolio Brain owns shared project/objective/provenance metadata and delegates learned-value mechanics to the canonical engine rather than forking it.

Only independently VERIFIED outcome receipts are eligible to change learned value. OBSERVED, INFERRED, UNKNOWN, CONTRADICTED, STALE or INVALID outcome records may remain auditable but cannot be converted into upstream learned-value observations.

Verified outcome attribution is conserved across memories per event, objective/project attribution is explicit, and untested memories retain the canonical neutral prior. Verified positive outcomes can raise learned value; verified negative outcomes can lower it; speculative volume alone cannot.
The shared value-memory ledger begins empty because no Step 6 verified outcome receipts were ingested. Empty verified memory is preferable to seeding unsupported lessons as verified truth.

Reuse canonical AI Business OS KnowledgeGraph and EntityCanonicalizer through exact source revision/blob pins. Portfolio Brain extends vocabulary with a lossless semantic envelope rather than copying or weakening the canonical graph/canonicalization engines.

Universal graph vocabulary covers the owner-requested 22 node types and all required relationships. Every node and edge requires provenance; graph connectivity and path existence have zero truth-upgrade effect.

The initial graph is evidence-conservative: it seeds all 12 registered projects, 8 repository identities, the owner objective, and four already CI-verified Portfolio Brain capabilities, but deliberately creates no CUSTOMER, REVENUE, OPPORTUNITY, or OUTCOME nodes without supporting evidence.

Identity canonicalization remains reversible and fail-closed. Hard identifier conflicts force KEEP_SEPARATE; ambiguous merges require HUMAN review with provenance; source records and conflicting losing values remain preserved; dependent live relationships gate reversal.

Only semantically compatible universal nodes/edges are projected into the canonical upstream graph. Unsupported portfolio semantics remain losslessly in the Portfolio Brain envelope rather than being coerced into a misleading upstream relation.

Step 8 operational continuation state uses sanitized GitHub Actions artifacts with the checked-in exact-SHA cursor store as bootstrap. Runtime cycles restore the newest non-expired state artifact and advance cursors only after successful observation receipts; no repository or downstream write is required.

Continuous observation is deterministic and model-free in Step 8. The runtime has four modes: event-driven single-repository observation, hourly full synchronization, daily synchronized learning-state rebuild, and weekly synchronized portfolio synthesis.

Minimum autonomy safety controls are mandatory before recurring execution: OBSERVE-only authority, model-call ceiling zero, downstream-write ceiling zero, external-action ceiling zero, finite API/repository/file/output/time budgets, retry limit two, shared serialized concurrency, repository-variable and file kill switches, and least-privilege contents/actions read permissions.

Step 8 workflow definitions are implementation-complete but intentionally staged on an isolated branch. GitHub scheduled triggers execute only from the default branch; recurring production activation is deferred to the later authorized operating-mode gate rather than bypassing Steps 9–25.

Step 8 runtime artifacts are sanitized operational continuation state, not independent truth evidence. Daily and weekly reports derive deterministically from current cursor state plus checked-in verified graph/memory registries and cannot upgrade evidence state.

blockers.summary: permitplate-state is currently public while durable architecture treats it as sensitive operational state; review intended visibility and access controls before integrating it into Portfolio Brain.

Production reuse requires live identity, privilege, deployment and independent-verifier evidence. Existing gateway token includes write operations; observers must not inherit it. Blocks integration/activation, not architecture completion.
ABVM active CI excludes retained browser suites and unit invocation; record current coverage/persistence/calendar limitations before future reliance.
Dedicated P00NSMASHER/portfolio-brain repository now exists and the Step 1 foundation is materialized and CI-verified.

P00NSMASHER/portfolio-brain is temporarily public by explicit owner choice. This does not block sanitized architecture work, but it blocks storage of secrets, private operational/customer payloads, sensitive evidence, or credentials until repository visibility is changed to private.
